claims.text: The rider does not press a wrong-entrance or wrong-block theory, and POL-NS-03 should not be applied on his behalf: the driver's own trace places him at 24.01 m from the Door 5 pin across 51 consecutive qualifying fixes, roughly 126 m inside the 150 m arrival radius that POL-NS-02 fixes for an AIRPORT pickup, and the pickup pin carries both the label 'Changi Airport Terminal 3, Door 5 ride-hail bay' and venue_id VEN-CHANGI-T3, matching the bay the driver named in the chat log. The rider's general point that the airport is large does not displace that measurement.

Two admissible artifacts contradict each other directly on rider presence in the waiting window and no live clause resolves the conflict, which is the POL-NS-09 escalation condition. The chat log has the rider saying at 22:41:40 'I am walking over now'; the rider track in the GPS artifact records 24 fixes from 22:40:30 to 22:48:10 at a single constant distance of 519.47 m from the pin and a single speed value of 0.0 kph - a device that never moved. POL-NS-04 is the only clause that tests rider position, and it is out of play: limb (b) fails because the driver replied at 22:41:58, 18 seconds after the rider's message, and limb (c) fails on the rider's own track (0 of 24 fixes inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius). The rider asks that the fee be held for a human reviewer under POL-NS-09 rather than resolved against him by the automated pipeline; under POL-GEN-03 an escalated amount is held, not collected or refunded.

The driver's case rests on a 20 second surplus, and the two endpoints of that surplus are the open question a reviewer should settle. The rider does not dispute that the arrival event, the in-geofence fixes, the RIDER_NO_SHOW termination and a continuous run are all present on the face of the record, nor that the single qualifying in-geofence run measures 500 seconds (22:40:00 to 22:48:20) against the 480 second AIRPORT minimum POL-NS-06 sets - a margin of 20 seconds, shortfall -20 s. But the run begins exactly at the trace's first fix and ends exactly at the cancellation second, and the per-fix accuracy values behind the 51 qualifying fixes are not reproduced in the brief. The rider asks the reviewer to verify those two endpoints against the raw trace before the fee is collected.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup road or waiting window: EV-ADVIS-09102-01 is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0, and that absence is itself citable under POL-GEN-02. Its effect is that POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable - there is no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory that could lawfully extend the driver's hold or allow separate in-geofence intervals to be summed - and any attempt by the driver's side to assert limb (i) against this MISSING artifact triggers POL-NS-09 rather than exonerating anyone. Nothing in the record therefore corroborates the driver's run beyond the bare 480 second arithmetic.

The rider's profile may not be used to build a finding against him. His prior_no_show_flags (1) and prior_disputes_filed (1), together with his rating and account age, are CONTEXT ONLY under POL-GEN-01, and prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter that is not rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d. The rider's citable counters are no_show_disputes_30d, which is 0, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d, which is 0 on both profiles together, so POL-NS-09(c) and POL-NS-09(d) are not engaged and the rider's history cannot be weighed against him.

claims.text: The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 2026-09-02T22:40:20+08:00, and the GPS trace places the driver inside the AIRPORT arrival radius at that moment: all 51 in-window fixes sit roughly 24 m from the pickup pin (min, mean and max distance all about 24.0 m), so the driver is well inside the 150 m radius that POL-NS-02 sets for the AIRPORT zone class. POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (b) are satisfied on the platform's own telemetry, and the zone class is AIRPORT on the trip record, not the 50 m STANDARD figure.

The driver held position inside the geofence for a single continuous qualifying run of 500 seconds, running from the first in-geofence fix at 22:40:00 to the last at 22:48:20. For an AIRPORT pickup the minimum dwell is 480 seconds, so the driver exceeded the requirement by 20 seconds (derived shortfall_sec of -20.0). POL-NS-01 limb (c) is met outright. The dwell correctly runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the 'arrived' marker, which is exactly what the clause requires, and the marker itself was already inside the radius.

The trip terminated with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW at 22:48:20, at or after the moment the 480-second dwell elapsed, and the trip record shows no boarding event: status is CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER and both started_at and ended_at are null. POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied, and the recognised reason code is one of the three the clause accepts.

The arrival marker is not false and POL-NS-05 does not bite. The 'arrived' event at 22:40:20 matches the nearest GPS fix at 22:40:00 within 20 seconds, far inside the 90-second clock-skew threshold, and at that time the driver was stationary: the trace shows a single distinct speed of 0.0 km/h and a position about 24 m from the pin. Neither trigger in the clause is engaged, since 24 m is nowhere near the 300 m distance trigger and 0.0 km/h is nowhere near the 15 km/h motion trigger.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider because limb (b) fails. The rider's only coordinating message — 'I am walking over now.' — was sent at 22:41:40, and the driver replied 'Okay, I will remain at Door 5.' at 22:41:58, eighteen seconds later, well within the 120-second window. Where the driver did reply within 120 seconds the clause does not apply regardless of the content of the reply, so the rider cannot shelter behind it.

Even setting limb (b) aside, limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes. The rider's track carries 24 fixes, none of them qualifying, and every one sits about 519 m from the pickup pin — far beyond the 200 m rider presence radius for an AIRPORT pickup. The rider was not at the pickup point at any point during the waiting window.

This is not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03. That clause governs a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; this driver was inside the 150 m radius, at roughly 24 m from the pin, for the whole run. The clause's precondition is not met, so its fault-allocation and pin-ambiguity goodwill limb is not in play and no platform-funded payment is owed on that basis.

The MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09102-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is citable only for its absence: no advisory covers this pickup road and waiting window. Its absence does not help the rider. POL-NS-06 limb (i) exists to let a driver sum separate in-geofence intervals where a lawful kerb restriction forced him to circulate, but there is only one in-geofence interval here and it already clears the 480-second minimum on its own, so there is no shortfall for limb (i) to cure and no shortfall for the rider to exploit.

The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee reconciles with the fee schedule. Under POL-NS-01 the chargeable amount is the GREATER of the zone-class fee and the vehicle-tier fee: the AIRPORT zone-class fee is SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee is SGD 6.00, and both dimensions produce SGD 6.00, matching fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee exactly. The charge was raised at 22:48:22, two seconds after the cancellation. No integrity defect arises under POL-NS-08(d).

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, that is SGD 4.80, with the residual 20 percent retained as the platform service fee. The rider's charge stands intact and the driver is owed money on this trip.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, and no other profile field is relied on for it. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 is approximately 0.008, far below 0.08. Both limbs must be met to withhold compensation and neither is, so compensation is paid rather than withheld.

The chat log shows the driver performing the coordination the platform asks of a driver: the system 'Your driver has arrived' fired at 22:40:21, the driver posted 'At T3 Door 5 ride-hail bay.' at 22:40:40, and after the rider said she was walking over he confirmed 'Okay, I will remain at Door 5.' at 22:41:58 and then stayed a further six and a half minutes before cancelling at 22:48:20. There is no unanswered rider message anywhere in this log, and the driver's counterparty statement that he replied immediately is borne out by the message timestamps.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is present. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, and no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence — the trip record, GPS trace and chat log are mutually consistent. The decisive facts of arrival and dwell are carried by artifacts at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02 confidence cap does not push this case below the 0.70 floor.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this was a genuine rider no-show at Changi T3. The SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is chargeable to the rider, and the driver is paid SGD 4.80 of it. Because the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd (POL-GEN-03): the ruling moves SGD 4.80 to the driver, and the rider's charge of SGD 6.00 stands as it presently is.

For the driver. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. (a) The trip record carries an 'arrived' event at 22:40:20. (b) The GPS trace puts the driver about 24 m from the Door 5 pin on 51 consecutive qualifying fixes, well inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius, so arrival is established under POL-NS-02. (c) The driver held position continuously for 500 seconds (22:40:00 to 22:48:20) against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum — a 20-second surplus — measured as the clause requires from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the 'arrived' tap. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 22:48:20 (after the minimum elapsed at 22:48:00) on reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event (started_at and ended_at null). The arrival marker is not false, so POL-NS-05 does not bite: it matches the nearest GPS fix within 20 seconds (limit 90), and at that moment the driver was stationary (0.0 km/h) and 24 m away, nowhere near the 300 m or 15 km/h triggers. POL-NS-03 does not apply, because the driver was inside the arrival radius rather than outside it, so no wrong-entrance or pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. The SGD 6.00 fee reconciles: the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_PLUS tier fee (SGD 6.00) is SGD 6.00, matching the fare breakdown, so POL-NS-08(d) raises no integrity defect.

For the rider. Your non-arrival point is measured and rejected. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you: the driver replied to 'I am walking over now.' at 22:41:58, 18 seconds after your 22:41:40 message, so limb (b) is not met, and in any event your own track shows 0 of 24 fixes inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius. Your escalation request under POL-NS-09 is not made out on any limb. Rider presence is not a fact this ruling turns on — POL-NS-06 refunds or declines whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded — and the chat log and the rider track agree on the material point, that you were not at the bay (about 519 m away, closing in). There is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts on arrival, dwell or termination: the trace has 51 fixes, no sampling gaps and only 20 seconds of clock skew, all well inside the POL-NS-08(a)–(b) limits, so limb (e) does not fire; both profiles show disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0 and no_show_disputes_30d of 0, so limbs (c) and (d) do not fire; and the deciding facts are carried by weight-1.0 artifacts, so the POL-GEN-02 confidence cap does not push the case below the 0.70 floor. Your request to verify the 500-second run's endpoints against the raw trace is noted as an open question rather than a ground for escalation: the run is documented by 51 consecutive in-geofence fixes with no gap. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09102-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) is citable only for its absence; it makes POL-NS-06 limb (i) unavailable, but that is immaterial, because the dwell cleared the 480-second minimum on its own and there is no shortfall for limb (i) to cure or for you to exploit.

Compensation. With POL-NS-01 satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of SGD 6.00, that is SGD 4.80, the platform retaining SGD 1.20. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1 divided by 120 completed trips is about 0.008 (below 0.08), so compensation is paid rather than withheld and no escalation follows. No profile field outside those POL-NS-07 names was used against the rider — rating, account age, lifetime counters and prior_no_show_flags are context only under POL-GEN-01, and they were not weighed against you.
